'''Batman Petrol Spor Kulübü''' is a professional [[Turkey|Turkish]] [[Association football|football]] club located in the city of [[Batman, Turkey|Batman]]. Formed in 1960, the club colours are red, white, and black and they play their home matches at Batman Stadium. The club is named Petrolspor because Batman is the largest producer of oil in [[Turkey]].<ref name=oil>[http://www.britannica.com/EBchecked/topic/56041/Batman Batman] britannica.com, accessed 25 June 2010</ref> The club is owned by [[TPAO]].<ref>https://beinsports.com.tr/haber/batman-petrolsporun-devredildigi-aciklandi</ref>"}}
